biggest_catch: The referral only counts if it is made by phone or in-branch at the time of account opening - online referrals don't qualify.
catches: Referring member earns $25 when the new member opens an eligible account; the new member earns $50.
New member must open a new checking account and add direct deposit, a loan, or a credit card.
Referral must be made by phone or in-branch at account opening; both the referring member and the new member must visit a PDCU branch or call.
Offer not valid for existing members opening additional accounts.
Offer may be changed or ended at any time; membership requirements apply (Michigan residency or relative of a member).
Rewards are considered interest income and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
No referral cap stated on the official page.
